results.name: Dead Bug
instructions: Begin by lying flat on your back with your arms extended straight up towards the ceiling and your legs lifted with your knees bent at a 90-degree angle.
Engage your core and slowly lower your right arm and left leg towards the floor, keeping your back flat on the floor and not allowing it to arch.
Return your right arm and left leg to the starting position.
Repeat the movement with your left arm and right leg. Continue alternating sides for the desired number of repetitions.
tips: Keep your core engaged throughout the exercise to maintain stability and support your lower back.
Avoid letting your leg touch the floor; keep it just above the floor to maintain tension in your muscles.
Ensure your lower back remains pressed into the floor to avoid unnecessary strain.
results.description: Dead Bug is a beginner single-joint isolation pushing exercise targeting the abs (waist). Performed with bodyweight, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Hip Flexors, Obliques.

results.name: Decline Levitating Sit Ups Bodyweight
instructions: Begin by lying on a decline bench with your feet secured under the footpads. Position your torso so it is parallel to the floor, 'levitating' off the bench.
Place your hands behind your head with your elbows pointing out to the sides.
Engage your core and lift your upper body towards your knees, keeping your back straight and avoiding pulling on your neck.
Lower your upper body back to the starting position with control, maintaining the parallel position. Repeat the movement for the desired number of repetitions.
tips: Breathe steadily throughout the exercise, exhaling as you lift your shoulders and inhaling as you lower them.
Ensure your lower back remains off the bench and parallel to the floor to engage your core muscles effectively.
Use a stable decline bench to prevent any movement or slipping during the exercise.
results.description: Decline Levitating Sit Ups Bodyweight is an intermediate single-joint isolation pushing exercise targeting the abs (waist). Performed with bodyweight, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Hip Flexors.

results.name: Decline Sit Ups Dumbbells
instructions: Secure your feet at the end of a decline bench and lie back with your knees slightly bent. Hold a dumbbell in each hand close to your chest.
Engage your core and lift your upper body off the bench by contracting your abdominal muscles.
Continue to lift your upper body until you are in a seated position, ensuring that the contraction is felt in your abs.
Slowly lower your upper body back to the starting position with control, keeping your core engaged. Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
tips: Focus on using your abdominal muscles to lift your body, rather than relying on momentum.
Breathe out as you sit up and breathe in as you return to the starting position.
Keep your feet securely anchored to the bench to stabilize your body throughout the exercise.
results.description: Decline Sit Ups Dumbbells is an intermediate single-joint isolation pushing exercise targeting the abs (waist). Performed with a dumbbell, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Biceps, Hip Flexors.

results.name: Diagonal Chop Cable
instructions: Anchor one end of the band at chest height. Stand with your right side facing the anchor point, with your feet shoulder-width apart, and grasp the handle with both hands. Extend your arms to hold the handle opposite your chest.
Pull the handle down and diagonally across your body, twisting your torso and pivoting your back foot to follow through. Bring the handle down towards the left side.
Slowly return to the starting position with control.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions, then switch sides to work in the opposite direction
tips: Perform the movement slowly and with control to maximize muscle activation and reduce injury risk.
Exhale as you pull the handle down and across your body, and inhale as you return to the starting position.
Use a lighter weight if needed to ensure proper form and gradually increase the resistance as you get stronger.
results.description: Diagonal Chop Cable is a beginner single-joint isolation pushing exercise targeting the abs (waist). Performed with a cable, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Shoulders, Core, Hip Flexors.

results.name: Diagonal Chop Left
instructions: Start standing with your feet shoulder-width apart, clasping your hands together and holding them extended opposite your chest.
Rotate your torso and simultaneously bring your hands diagonally across your body towards your left hip, bending your knees slightly as you turn.
Keep your arms extended and pivot your right foot as you rotate to protect your knee from strain.
Return to the starting position in a controlled manner, bringing your hands back opposite your chest.
tips: Engage your core throughout the movement to stabilize your spine and enhance power.
Pivot on your feet during the rotation to ensure a full range of motion and to reduce stress on your knees.
Focus on exhaling as you chop down and inhaling as you return to the starting position.
Maintain a slight bend in your knees throughout the exercise to aid in balance and prevent strain on your joints.
results.description: Diagonal Chop Left is an intermediate single-joint isolation pushing exercise targeting the abs (waist). Performed with bodyweight, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Shoulders, Arms.

results.name: Diagonal Chop Right
instructions: Start standing with your feet shoulder-width apart, clasping your hands together and holding them extended opposite your chest.
Rotate your torso and simultaneously bring your hands diagonally across your body towards your right hip, bending your knees slightly as you turn.
Keep your arms extended and pivot your right foot as you rotate to protect your knee from strain.
Return to the starting position in a controlled manner, bringing your hands back opposite your chest.
tips: Engage your core throughout the movement to stabilize your spine and enhance power.
Pivot on your feet during the rotation to ensure a full range of motion and to reduce stress on your knees.
Focus on exhaling as you chop down and inhaling as you return to the starting position.
Maintain a slight bend in your knees throughout the exercise to aid in balance and prevent strain on your joints.
results.description: Diagonal Chop Right is an intermediate single-joint isolation pushing exercise targeting the abs (waist). Performed with bodyweight, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Shoulders, Arms.

results.name: Dragonfly
instructions: Lie on your back with your arms extended overhead and grasp a stable support. Extend your legs straight together and hold them just above the floor.
Engage your core and lift both legs upward while rolling your hips off the floor until your body is supported on your shoulders.
Slowly lower your hips back to the floor, then continue lowering your straight legs until they are just above the floor without touching it.
Repeat the movement with controlled, continuous motion while keeping your legs together and as straight as possible.
tips: Keep your legs together throughout the entire movement.
Lift your hips by engaging your core rather than using momentum.
Lower your legs slowly to maintain tension in your abdominal muscles.
Inhale as you lower your legs and exhale as you lift them upward.
results.description: Dragonfly is an intermediate single-joint isolation pushing exercise targeting the abs (waist). Performed with bodyweight, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Hip Flexors, Lower Back, Forearms.

results.name: Dumbbell Ab Crunch
instructions: Lie on your back with your knees bent and feet flat on the floor, hip-width apart. Hold a dumbbell with both hands straight over your chest.
Lift your head, shoulders, and upper back off the floor by contracting your abdominal muscles.
Raise the dumbbell towards the ceiling as you perform the crunch, keeping your arms straight. Pause for a moment at the top of the movement, squeezing your abs.
Slowly lower your upper body back to the starting position, keeping control of the movement. Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
tips: Keep your lower back pressed against the floor throughout the exercise to avoid straining it.
Avoid using your neck muscles to lift your head; focus on using your abdominal muscles.
Breathe out as you lift your upper body and breathe in as you lower it.
results.description: Dumbbell Ab Crunch is an intermediate single-joint isolation pushing exercise targeting the abs (waist). Performed with a dumbbell, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Shoulders, Hip Flexors, Obliques.

results.name: Dumbbell Decline Overhead Sit-Up
instructions: Begin by lying on a decline bench with your feet secured, holding a dumbbell in each hand extended overhead.
Slowly lift your shoulders, and upper back off the bench while simultaneously bringing the dumbbells up and over your head.
Continue to lift your torso until you are in an upright position with the dumbbell directly above your head.
Slowly lower yourself back down to the starting position, keeping the dumbbells extended overhead.
tips: Keep your neck in a neutral position to avoid strain.
Focus on a smooth and controlled motion to maximize core engagement.
Avoid using momentum to lift yourself; rely on your core muscles.
results.description: Dumbbell Decline Overhead Sit-Up is an intermediate single-joint isolation pushing exercise targeting the abs (waist). Performed with a dumbbell, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Hip Flexors, Shoulders.

results.name: Dumbbell Diagonal Chop
instructions: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart, holding a dumbbell with both hands extended opposite your chest.
Rotate your torso and lower the dumbbell diagonally across your body to the left side, extending your arms fully as you reach downward, while pivoting your feet towards your left side.
In a controlled motion, bring the dumbbell back up to the starting position, reversing the diagonal path.
Repeat the movement for the desired number of repetitions, then switch sides and repeat.
tips: Rotate your torso and pivot your feet to allow for a full range of motion.
Maintain a firm grip on the dumbbell to ensure control.
Perform the movement in a controlled manner to avoid swinging the dumbbell.
results.description: Dumbbell Diagonal Chop is an intermediate single-joint isolation pushing exercise targeting the abs (waist). Performed with a dumbbell, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Shoulders.
